items.title: See what's new before you update
items.body: Checking for updates now shows exactly what changed in the new version, so you know what you're installing.

items.title: Set a time on reminders from Today
items.body: The Set reminder window on Today now has the same Time field as the Reminders page.

items.title: Page View reads like a real document
items.body: Notes sit in a centred column at a comfortable reading width, with more space between paragraphs and softer text that's easier on the eyes.

items.title: Headings look the same everywhere
items.body: Headings are now the same size while you write and after you save, in every view.

items.title: A clearer Backup tab
items.body: See when your last backup ran and when the next one is due, what's included, and step-by-step instructions for restoring on a new PC.

items.title: The details panel no longer shifts your note
items.body: Opening tags and linked thoughts in Page View no longer squeezes the page or hides the Graph, Zen mode, PDF and Save buttons.

items.title: Reminder end dates no longer disappear
items.body: Editing a reminder could quietly clear a stop-repeating date set elsewhere. Both reminder forms now work the same way.

items.title: Reorganised Settings
items.body: Settings is split into General, Appearance, Security, Backup, Updates and Help, with consistent text and button sizes throughout.

items.title: Tools menu matches the sidebar
items.body: Transfer Files and Year-in-Review now look and behave like the rest of the navigation.

items.title: Clicking a note in the knowledge graph opens it
items.body: One click opens the note, or asks for the password if it's locked. Hovering a dot highlights its connections.

items.title: Graph dots stay where you drag them
items.body: A dot you move now stays put instead of drifting off to the edge of the screen.
